reference:
A Greener Street: Weighing the Trade-offs

Last month, the Riverside Community Group met to discuss a plan for Green Street. The plan has three parts: more trees, new bike lanes, and a small garden. The group wants a cleaner and quieter street. However, some people are worried about the cost and the changes. “If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner,” said Mrs. Chen, the group leader. “Trees also make the street cooler in summer. But we must think about the cost. Each tree costs about 200 yuan, and we need 30 trees. Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.” Mr. Li, a shop owner, said, “If you take away parking spaces for bike lanes, some customers will go to other streets. Because my shop needs parking, I am worried.” The group also talked about the small garden. “If we build the garden, children will have a safe place to play,” said Mrs. Chen.
